name: DRAC Network
rootCause: DeFi project DRAC Network appeared Rug Pull, with the price of the token $TEDDY dropping 99.4%. 10,000 $BNB and 2 million $BUSD have been slowly transferred to Binance. It is said that the deployer deployed the contract and transferred a large quantity of $TEDDY to 0xdbe8ef79a1a7b57fbb73048192edf6427e8a5552, then pump and dump the price of $TEDDY.
